Multi-Stage Calculation & Reverse Gross-Up Methodology

Stage 1 (Platform Deduction): After_Platform = Gross × (1 - Platform_Pct) - Platform_Fixed. Stage 2 (Payout Rail & FX Uncertainty Band): Net_USD = After_Platform × (1 - Rail_Pct - FX_Spread_[Min..Max]) - Rail_Fixed - Intermediary_[Min..Max]. Stage 3 (Local Tax Provision): Final_Net = Net_USD × (1 - Local_Tax_Pct). Multi-Stage Reverse Invoice Solver: Required_Gross = (Target_Net / ((1 - Tax_Pct) × (1 - Rail_Pct - FX_Spread)) + Rail_Fixed + Platform_Fixed) / (1 - Platform_Pct).

Reference Notes & FAQ

Why do generic fee calculators overestimate freelancer take-home pay?

Most calculators only subtract a single gateway fee (like Upwork's 10% or Stripe's 2.9%). In reality, cross-border freelancers face a 4-stage deduction chain: (1) Marketplace/client platform fee, (2) Payout rail withdrawal fee, (3) Currency conversion (FX) spread or SWIFT intermediary deduction ($10–$35), and (4) Local entrepreneur turnover tax.

Why is Wise marked as restricted for receiving in Armenia while supported in Georgia and the Philippines?

Wise's multi-currency receiving account features vary by resident jurisdiction. Residents of Armenia cannot currently open local USD/EUR receiving bank details on Wise, making Payoneer, Lemon Squeezy MoR, or direct bank wires the primary options, whereas residents of Georgia, Serbia, the Philippines, and India have broader Wise route access.

Does this calculator invent live exchange rates?

Never. Exchange rates fluctuate every minute and banks apply custom spreads. We provide a user-editable Reference Exchange Rate field and calculate transparent Best-Case to Worst-Case Net Payout ranges so you can see the exact impact of FX markups and SWIFT intermediary fees.
